title: Pelican Paradise | Scenic Stays
meta_description: Experience luxury at Pelican Paradise, a Gulf-front 10-bedroom estate on Scenic 30A combining two private homes into one expansive retreat. Perfect for lar
description_expanded: Pelican Paradise is a Gulf-front retreat on Scenic 30A offering 10 bedrooms and 8.5 bathrooms across two private homes reserved together as one seamless stay. Ideal for large families or group getaways, this unique setup provides both shared spaces and private areas—giving everyone room to relax without feeling crowded. Please Note: This listing includes both Pelican Paradise A and Pelican Paradise B. They are booked together and function as one combined property for your stay. Located within the gated Camp Creek Lake community, Pelican Paradise offers a rare combination of privacy, space, and direct beach access. With two homes side by side, guests can gather together or spread out comfortably across multiple living areas, kitchens, and outdoor spaces. Each home features a thoughtfully designed multi-level layout. The ground floors include additional living spaces with wet bars—perfect for casual hangouts after a day at the beach or pool. Upper levels showcase open-concept living areas, spacious kitchens, and seating designed for group meals and shared moments. Expansive balconies and upper-level suites offer sweeping Gulf views, creating the perfect setting for sunrise mornings and sunset evenings. Comfortable bedrooms throughout both homes include king suites, bunk rooms, and additional guest accommodations designed to sleep large groups with ease. Outside, enjoy two private pools, outdoor seating, and a grill, along with a private boardwalk leading directly to the beach. Complimentary beach gear is also available to make your stay even more convenient. Whether you’re planning a family reunion, group vacation, or extended stay along 30A, Pelican Paradise offers the space, layout, and location to bring everyone together—without sacrificing comfort or privacy. Guests must be above the age of 25, or must be accompanied by an adult chaperone throughout their stay. Pets are not welcome to accompany their families at this home, events are not allowed and it is a strictly non smoking property.
